HISD Toast

Brief, non-blocking feedback pinned to the bottom-end of the viewport. Four semantic variants map to the status tokens; meaning is carried by the glyph shape, the text, and the status-colored rail together — never color alone. Success and info auto-dismiss after 5 s; warning and danger persist until dismissed. At most three stack; the oldest fades out when a fourth arrives. The right panel is forced to data-theme="dark" and inherits dark purely through semantic tokens — no component-specific dark CSS.

Light theme

Use the buttons to emit each variant. Try emitting four quickly to see the oldest fade.

          Copy-paste snippet

          <!-- Two live regions, pinned bottom-end. polite for success/info/warning,
     assertive for danger. Put one pair near the end of <body>. -->
<ol class="hisd-toast-region" role="status"  aria-live="polite"    aria-relevant="additions"></ol>
<ol class="hisd-toast-region" role="alert"   aria-live="assertive" aria-relevant="additions"></ol>

<!-- A single toast (append to the region matching its urgency). The icon is
     decorative — its meaning is duplicated by the text — so it is aria-hidden.
     The dismiss button is icon-only and carries an aria-label. -->
<li class="hisd-toast hisd-toast--success" role="group" aria-label="Success">
  <span class="hisd-toast__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  <div class="hisd-toast__body">
    <p class="hisd-toast__title">Saved</p>
    <p class="hisd-toast__message">Your changes were saved.</p>
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="hisd-toast__dismiss" aria-label="Dismiss notification">
    <span class="hisd-toast__dismiss-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  </button>
</li>

<!-- Variants: hisd-toast--success | --info | --warning | --danger.
     Auto-dismiss success/info after 5s; warning/danger persist. -->
